# Vendored dependency

`MLX-DLSS/` is an unmodified source snapshot from
https://github.com/iamwavecut/MLX-DLSS at revision
`0ca2deab092fe6f3e331bf4f616271dbc64521d0`.

It is included as ordinary source files, not a Git submodule. Its complete
LICENSE and NOTICE are retained. The app uses DLSSCore, DLSSMLX and DLSSMedia;
model preparation uses the standalone Python tools. The upstream sample app,
CLI and documentation remain in the snapshot for provenance.

This folder contains no pretrained model weights or NVIDIA DLLs.
